sample_unit: primary care physicians and nurses (survey respondents)

links.outcome: Proportion of primary care professionals who had received AI training and wanted training
links.effect: 65.8% had not received any AI training; 91.4% would like to receive training.
links.quote: 65.8% indicated that they had not received any AI training and 91.4% that they would like to receive training.

links.outcome: Staff AI literacy and training gap among primary care professionals
links.effect: 85.7% said they understood the concept of AI, but there were discrepancies in the use of this tool; 65.8% had received no AI training and 91.4% wanted training.
links.quote: And 85.7% indicated that they understood the concept of AI but there were discrepancies in the use of this tool; 65.8% indicated that they had not received any AI training and 91.4% that they would like to receive training.

screen.reason: Cross-sectional survey of primary care clinicians assessing knowledge, perceptions, and readiness regarding AI implementation in healthcare.
